user.title: Connect the igloohome API
user.description: Use the client ID and client secret from an individual igloohome API client (client credentials). The next step lists locks returned by the account. The lock itself is not contacted.

locks.title: Choose locks
locks.description: These devices were returned by GET /home/devices/support-pins. The label shows the device id and its prefix. It does not name a product model. If you are not sure which lock this is, open the igloohome app or API portal, read the device id (the Bluetooth name, for example IGB403fe3b9d), and compare the prefix with https://docs.igloohome.co/home/supported-devices. A retail name such as Smart Deadbolt 4 Metal Grey is not a row on that page.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the igloohome API
reauth_confirm.description: The saved client secret was rejected. Enter a new secret for the same client ID.

error.invalid_auth: igloohome rejected the client ID or client secret.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the igloohome API.
error.payment_required: igloohome returned HTTP 402. After the trial the published price is $2 per active lock per month.
error.no_devices: The account returned no AlgoPIN-capable devices.
error.select_lock: Choose at least one lock from the list.
error.unknown: The igloohome API returned an unexpected error.

abort.already_configured: This igloohome API client is already configured.
abort.no_devices: The account returned no AlgoPIN-capable devices.

init.title: Choose locks
init.description: The list was loaded again from GET /home/devices/support-pins. Labels show the device id and prefix, not a product model. Compare the device id in the igloohome account with https://docs.igloohome.co/home/supported-devices if the prefix is unfamiliar. Smart Deadbolt 4 Metal Grey is not a row on that page.

error.invalid_auth: igloohome rejected the saved credentials. Use Reconfigure / reauthentication.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the igloohome API.
error.payment_required: igloohome returned HTTP 402. After the trial the published price is $2 per active lock per month.
error.select_lock: Choose at least one lock from the list.

create_hourly_algopin.name: Create hourly AlgoPIN
create_hourly_algopin.description: Create an hourly AlgoPIN in the igloohome cloud. No Bridge is used and no PIN algorithm runs locally. Times are in the Home Assistant timezone and are converted to UTC. The PIN is returned only in the service response.

create_daily_algopin.name: Create daily AlgoPIN
create_daily_algopin.description: Create a daily AlgoPIN in the igloohome cloud. No Bridge is used and no PIN algorithm runs locally. Times are in the Home Assistant timezone and are converted to UTC. The PIN is returned only in the service response.

revoke_algopin.name: Revoke AlgoPIN
revoke_algopin.description: Ask a linked Bridge to delete a PIN over Bluetooth (job type 5). If the Bridge cannot reach the lock, the code stays. A job id does not guarantee deletion. The 256-hour limit in the igloohome docs is not applied here. The PIN is not stored.
